clause_name: RLA-010 — Residential Lease — Parties and Premises
library_question: Does this agreement use GH Real Estate as Landlord and the identified dwelling without a nonstandard party or premises structure?

blocks.text: This Residential Lease Agreement (the "Lease") is entered into by and between GH Real Estate, LLC, a Kansas limited liability company ("Landlord"), and the individual Tenant(s) named on the cover page and signature page (individually and collectively, "Tenant").

Landlord leases to Tenant, and Tenant leases from Landlord, the residential apartment located at ____________________________________________, together with the fixtures, Landlord-provided appliances, assigned keys/access devices, any approved storage unit, and permitted common-area rights described in this Lease or a signed addendum (the "Premises").
